name: Do all plumbing repairs require post-repair leak testing?

mainEntity.name: Do all plumbing repairs require post-repair leak testing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most plumbing repairs benefit from some form of post-repair leak testing, especially those involving water supply lines, drain pipes, or fixtures where water is actively flowing. Even minor repairs like faucet or toilet component replacements should ideally have a quick visual check. For larger, more invasive repairs such as pipe replacements, slab leak repairs, or significant system modifications, comprehensive testing is absolutely essential to ensure the entire system is watertight and functioning correctly. It's a best practice to prevent recurrence and confirm the repair's quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most plumbing repairs require some testing, especially for water supply and drain lines. Comprehensive testing is essential for larger, more invasive repairs.
